description: Hi! I'm Andualem Genetu (Engineer AnduTechLab) from Ethiopia, competing solo for Challenge #7: Field Shift with "Andualem Smart AI Farm Hub." Built with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, Node.js, and ESP32 IoT sensors (soil moisture, temp/humidity, ultrasonic water level, automated Blynk relay),Solar System, my bilingual (English/Amharic) offline-capable app fuses live field telemetry with NASA POWER, MERRA-2, MODIS NDVI, and GPM data for evidence-based crop rotation and irrigation advisories Using Voice.
